digest.claim_restated: Post 9 is the series' scoreboard, not a new argument: Hegel's mechanism objection stood where it was true, the program refuted its own starting reading (coordination was not Hegel's glue — recognition was), HC1–HC6 tally honestly as two closed / one open / one undecided / one probe / one exhibit, and sublation marks the outer edge of the homology — the q210/q211 core-merger is the one computed structure that catches cancel-preserve-lift in an exact number (Φ 2.0 → 3.0) while missing, in three separate ways, the immanence that makes the movement Hegel's; the two instruments draw the same boundary on the easy cases and part on the hard ones.

new_scholarship.relevance: A MISSING ANCESTOR the post should name alongside Fuchs and Günther: F. W. Lawvere, "Display of graphics and their applications, as exemplified by 2-categories and the Hegelian 'taco'," Proc. First Int. Conf. on Algebraic Methodology and Software Technology (U. Iowa, 1989) — per nLab, the origin of the formal definition of the Aufhebung of a level in a topos: the minimal level that "resolves the opposites" of a lower level (skeleton/sheaf condition). This is the most exact formalization of the word Aufhebung in existence, and a hostile reviewer of the "Naming the ancestors" section will reach for it. It strengthens rather than threatens the lab's edge: Lawvere's Aufhebung is categorical/structural — a which-level-resolves question, not a partition-sensitive quantity — so the "missing quantitative step" claim survives with a third ancestor named. PDF is on the Lawvere Archives (lawverearchives.com).

F. W. Lawvere, "Some thoughts on the future of category theory," in Category Theory (Como 1990), Springer LNM 1488 (1991), pp. 1–13 — the companion statement of levels/Aufhebung; cite with the 1989 paper if the ancestor is named.

nLab, "Aufhebung" — expository source verifying the definition ("a minimal level which resolves the opposites of level i") and the Lawvere citation chain (1989b origin; 1996 history; 2002 presheaf-topos existence results). Use for orientation, cite Lawvere primary in print.

"Lawvere's fourth open problem: Levels in the topos of symmetric simplicial sets" (arXiv 2503.03439, 2025) — shows the Lawvere-Aufhebung line is a live mathematical research program, not an antiquarian footnote; useful one-clause support if Lawvere is added.

Negative sweep result: searches for 2024–2026 work putting a quantitative measure on sublation/Aufhebung-as-emergence returned only blog material ("quantum dialectics") and no citable scholarship, and no Hegel-and-IIT paper surfaced. The draft's hedged "may be the first to put an irreducibility number on the moment a smaller whole survives inside a larger one" stands, with one adjacency worth remembering if a reviewer raises it: the IIT macro/micro literature (Hoel/Albantakis/Tononi 2016 PNAS; Marshall et al. black-boxing) quantifies Φ across scales but not a smaller complex persisting as member of a larger complex, which remains q210/q211's claim.

digest.refutation_condition: None of its own — the post is the scoreboard and inherits every unresolved objection from Posts 1–8, including the standing one it now foregrounds: that the operators and the power concept may need little of the Φ machinery to stand. Its local exposure is bookkeeping: it is wrong if any tally entry is wrong (e.g., if HC4's underdetermination were actually a closure, or if a computed sub-complex reading falsified the containment guard), and its affirmative OR-case answer falls if a scalable proxy is shown to recover the verdict above chance past the exact-computation regime — which q81/q82 currently show it does not across sizes.
digest.guard_check: Anticipation guard: clean — the draft explicitly disavows it ("The series has said from Post 1 that it never claims Hegel anticipated Φ… He reached a different criterion") and consistently keeps homology altitude ("a rhyme," "two lines that meet on the easy cases and part on the hard ones"). Demotion guard: two flags in "What the ledger owes." (1) "the apparatus earned its keep only by being able to say more than yes-or-no… That is a real surplus, but it is a thin one to hang two years on" — "thin one to hang two years on" crosses from stating the objection into endorsing the demotion; the paragraph's own OR-case and near-chance-proxy answers show the surplus is structural (which members, how much, and a binding the flag cannot see), not thin. (2) "I would rather say so than reach for the sanctioned line about principled exploration and move on" — this sneers at the program's actual affirmative framing (principled exploration IS the contribution per the dissertation spine) as if it were evasion. Both are fixable by keeping the objection at full strength and cutting the self-deprecating verdicts: state the objection, then give the OR-case, the exact-regime boundary, and the open beyond-regime question — which the draft already does in the next paragraph. The sublation section's "the apparatus only ever reads a step from outside" is instrument-reach, not demotion: clean.
